verdict.rationale: Cua is infrastructure for computer-use agents: Spaces, Driver, SDK, Lume and Bench. Nothing in the evidence shows the product itself generating AI insights or suggestions from a user's data. The agents users bring (Claude Code, Codex) can work inside Spaces, but those are external tools, not Cua's own capability. Cua Bench's @evaluate_task returns reward scores, which are not AI-generated insights.
